title: Lin-Manuel Miranda, Hillary Clinton and Paul Rudd Teaming Up For Karaoke Fundraiser in Defense of Democracy
summary: The special Oct. 19 event will help support the Latino Victory Project and Onward Together.
contentText:
The worlds of Broadway, Hollywood and politics will converge in New York on Oct. 19 for a very special night in support of defending democracy and civic representation. The event, hosted by Hamilton legend Lin-Manuel Miranda, former First Lady and Sec. of State Hillary Clinton and Ant-Man star Paul Rudd will feature a star-studded lineup of special guest performers singing along to their favorite songs for a very good cause.

Organizers said each entry will directly support two organizations dedicated to the defense of democracy, voter mobilization and civic representation, including the Latino Victory Project , which has been working to build political power in the Latino community since 2014 through voter education and support for Latino candidates at every level of government. The second group, Onward Together , encourages Americans to “organize, get involved and run for office” while advancing progressive values and encouraging people to resist bullying, hate, falsehoods and divisiveness in search of a more inclusive, democratic America for all.

The event will take place just two weeks before the crucial midterm elections on Nov. 3 in which Democrats are seeking to flip either the U.S. House and/or Senate in an effort to wrest control of one of the branches of government from Republicans. A recent Pew Research Center poll found that a narrow majority of Americans (55%) are confident that the midterms will be conducted fairly and accurately, down from 61% ahead of the 2024 elections and 64% in 2022.
